title: HealthCheckVerdict
description: The STRUCTURED verdict the LLM must return. This schema is the contract between the (non-deterministic) model and the (deterministic) CI gate. The model PROPOSES a verdict; this schema VALIDATES it; CI then deterministically decides whether to roll back based on the boolean `healthy` and the process exit code. Never let free-form model text drive the rollback decision.

healthy.description: true only if the deployment appears healthy and safe to keep. This single boolean drives the CI rollback gate.

confidence.description: Model self-reported confidence in the verdict, 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (certain).

reasons.description: Concrete, evidence-backed bullet reasons for the verdict (cite pod names, restart counts, event messages, log lines).

summary.description: One-to-three sentence plain-English summary suitable for a CI job summary or PR comment.
